answer: Sybil resistance employs a verifiable capital-bonded identity mechanism, requiring substantial stake. Fraudulent identity detection triggers immediate, complete stake forfeiture, acting like a swift falcon. An attacker's cumulative capital lockup far exceeds any potential reward, ensuring strictly negative expected utility; this explicit economic signal deters such endeavors. The prohibitive cost thus guarantees that colluding agents cannot gain control, sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance at its operational zenith.
